notat: The LucasArts logo screen. Copy the logo, the small figure and all lettering ('LUCAS', 'Arts', 'LucasArts Entertainment Company') exactly, letter by letter. Do not modernize the logo. Keep the dark background plain.

Sam and Max's office, messy on purpose. Keep all the clutter, papers on the floor, bullet holes, picture frames, the dart board, the TV and the small 'LOVE' sign on the cabinet exactly as they are, in the same number and place. Do not tidy, straighten or complete anything.
The hallway outside the office. Keep the stairs, the railing posts (the same number), the doors, the broken glass and the bullet holes exactly.

The street outside the office. Copy every sign letter by letter: 'NO WAY', 'VEHICLES WILL BE STOLEN', 'SOILED OFFICE SPACE AVAILABLE', 'Bosco's', 'GUNS LIQUOR BABY NEEDS', 'NEW', 'USED', 'COME ON IN' and 'REALLY BAD FOOD'. The sign that is cut off at the right edge stays cut off. Keep the blood stain and the litter.

The map of the USA that the player uses to pick destinations. Keep the outline of the country, the coast, the grid lines and every map icon (burgers, fish, guitar, skull flag, tomato and so on) exactly in shape, size and position: they are clickable places. Copy 'GREETINGS from the USA' and the speech bubble 'HI THERE!' exactly. The game draws new destinations on top of the map; do not add any.
Inside Snuckey's. Copy the 'fountain' sign and any lettering on the racks and boxes exactly. Keep every item on the shelves, in the same number and place.
Outside Snuckey's. Copy both 'Snuckey's' signs exactly, letter by letter, with the same style of lettering.
The carnival entrance. Copy the signs exactly: 'KUSHMAN BROS SHOWS', 'CLOSED', 'HALL of ODDITIES', 'WEIRD' and 'CREEPY'. Keep the posters on the tent as they are.

The freak show tent. Copy the signs exactly: 'INSECT LAD', 'HUMAN ENIGMA', 'MAN OR CHICKEN DUMPLING?' and 'BRUNO THE FROZENEST BIG FOOT'. Keep the stands, the spot lights and the exhibits as they are.
The carnival midway. Copy the signs exactly: 'CONE OF TRAGEDY', 'WAK A RAT', 'WIN', 'TRIXIE' on the trailer and 'GUN'. Keep the flags, the fences and the cable on the ground.
Close-up of the Wak-A-Rat game. Copy 'WAK-A-RAT' on the box and the score panel 'HIT 20 WIN' exactly. Keep the five holes as they are: the game draws the rats in them.
Close-up of the Wak-A-Rat game. Copy 'WAK-A-RAT' on the box exactly. Keep the five holes as they are: the game draws in them.
Inside Trixie's trailer. Keep the posters, the vase with flowers and the star on the box as they are, and copy any lettering on the shelf boxes exactly.
Copy the sign 'TUNNEL OF LOVE' exactly. Keep the cupids, the devil and the hearts as they are.
Inside the Tunnel of Love, a dark ride with scenes in the walls. Copy 'CORN DOGS' and 'HOT' exactly. Keep every figure in the scenes as it is; do not add figures.
Copy the signs exactly: 'PRO SHOP', 'GATOR GOLF', 'DUNK THE BEAST' and 'CLOSED'.

The Gator Golf driving range. The round buttons 'SWING' and 'QUIT' are game controls: copy them exactly. Copy 'DUNK THE BEAST' on the booth. Keep the targets (clown head, monkey head, skull, windmill, dragon) exactly in place.
Copy 'DUNK THE BEAST' on the booth exactly, and keep the target circles as they are.
The World's Largest Ball of Twine. Copy the signs exactly: 'WORLDS LARGEST BALL OF TWINE', 'TRAM' and both 'MUSEUM' signs with their arrows.
The twine museum. Keep the exhibits and the framed pictures as they are, and copy any lettering exactly.
The rotating restaurant. Copy 'SEAFOOD' and 'FRESH FISH' exactly. Keep the fishing nets and the lamps as they are.

The view through the coin binoculars: the binocular frame on the left with the '25¢' coin slot, and the landscape panorama on the right. Keep the panorama exactly as it is, with no new landmarks: the game draws discovered places on top of it.
The fish deck on top of the ball of twine. Keep the striped pole, the cable car, the fish and the deck rails as they are.
Copy 'BAIT', 'WORLD of FISH' and 'FISH FEED' exactly.
Copy 'MYSTERY VORTEX' exactly. The wild colors and the distorted, tilted shapes are intentional: keep them.
Inside the Mystery Vortex: a room with impossible, tilted perspective on purpose. Do not straighten anything. Keep every door, the stairs, the piano, the mirror and the 8-ball exactly.
Keep the three horseshoe magnets, their colors and the levers exactly.
The gift shop, drawn upside down on purpose. The signs 'MUSEUM GIFT SHOP', 'VORTEX MINI', 'BIG FOOT', 'BEEF' and 'CLOSED' are upside down or mirrored: keep them exactly as they are, upside down.
Copy the 'FROG ROCK' sign exactly. Keep the shape of the rock exactly: it is a puzzle location.
Copy 'BUMPUSVILLE' and 'CB' exactly. Keep the statue, the fountain and the music notes as they are.
Keep the portrait of Conroy Bumpus and the framed records exactly, in the same number.

Copy the sign 'EDU...MENT' exactly as it shows: the middle of the sign is covered by a plain panel where the game draws an object; keep that panel plain. Keep the stuffed heads and the trophies as they are.
Copy the license plate text 'MA TRUK' on the monster truck bed exactly.
Copy 'BUMPUSVILLE SINGS' exactly. Keep every animal head on the wall as it is: the game animates their eyes and mouths.
The virtual reality world: flat, untextured polygons on purpose. Keep every facet flat and sharp-edged; do not add texture, detail or smooth shading to the polygons.
The brain machine. Copy 'BUMPUSVILLE' on the screen exactly, and keep the blocks on the screen and the cables and plugs in their places: they are part of a puzzle.
Copy 'SAVAGE JUNGLE INN' and 'WELCOME PODIATRALLY GIFTED' exactly, letter by letter.
Copy the poster 'THE REPTILE QUEEN' exactly. Keep the toucan, the lizard and the stone head as they are.
The party hall. Keep every balloon, the band silhouettes and the dancers as they are, in the same number.
Copy 'CELEBRITY VEGETABLE MUSEUM' and the small sign by the giant pumpkin exactly, letter by letter. Keep the corn statues and the vegetable patches as they are.
Copy 'DINO BUNGEE NATIONAL MEMORIAL' exactly. Keep the four faces of Mount Rushmore exactly in shape and position.
Copy 'TARPIT SLIDE', 'BUNGEE' and 'YOU MUST BE THIS TALL' exactly.
The Car Bomb game board. Keep the grid exactly, with the same number of cells and lines in the same places: the game puts the pieces in the cells. Copy 'CAR BOMB' exactly.
End credits and fireworks. The unusual colors of the credit panels are intentional: keep them as they are. Copy any lettering exactly.
The Highway Surfing game. Keep the two boxes at the top and the road exactly; the game draws the cars, signs and numbers on top. Copy 'Score:' and the other lettering exactly.
Silhouettes on purpose: the flat gray shapes mark where the game draws clothes and items. Keep every gray silhouette exactly in shape and position, flat gray with no detail, on the plain background.
The dress-up game. Copy 'PUSH ME!' exactly. Keep the arrows and both dressed-up figures as they are.
Inside the fish's mouth, looking out: Sam and Max are dark silhouettes against the light. Keep the silhouettes dark and the view outside as it is.
Credit panels. Keep the panels exactly as they are, including their gray colors.
The Mystery Vortex snow globe held in two hands. Copy 'THE MYSTERY VORTEX' and the small lettering on the globe exactly; on the left half the lettering is mirrored: keep it mirrored.
Picture cards. Copy 'MAX'S WAX' and both 'Wax Me' exactly. Keep the crayons in the box, in the same number and colors.
